title: AI Form Agent Configuration
description: Configuration file for the persian-form-agent CLI tool

$schema.description: Path to this JSON Schema file for editor autocomplete

paths.description: File system paths within the target project

formComponents.description: Directory containing local form field components (e.g. src/components/form/fields)

formsOutput.description: Directory where generated form files will be written (e.g. src/features/forms)

customValidators.description: Path to custom Yup validator extensions file (e.g. src/utils/validation/yup-extensions.ts)

schemas.description: Directory for generated form TypeScript interfaces/types (e.g. src/schemas)

validationLibrary.description: Validation library to use (currently only 'yup' is supported)

cache.description: Cache configuration for react-persian-form file listings

path.description: Path to the cache file relative to the project root (e.g. .cache/rpf-listing.json)

ttlHours.description: How many hours before the cache is considered stale and refetched from GitHub

reactPersianForm.description: Configuration for the react-persian-form component library source

repoOwner.description: GitHub owner (org or user) of the react-persian-form repository

ref.description: Git ref (branch, tag, or commit SHA) to pin for fetching files

components.description: Path to components directory in the react-persian-form repo

validators.description: Path to validators directory in the react-persian-form repo

utils.description: Path to utils directory in the react-persian-form repo

wizardComponent.description: Import paths for the Wizard component used in multi-step forms

importPath.description: Import path for the Wizard component (e.g. ~/components/atoms/Wizard/Wizard)

typesImportPath.description: Import path for Wizard types including WizardStepProps (e.g. ~/components/atoms/Wizard/Wizard.types)
